t0027-01.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
t0027-01.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.

t0027-02.gloss: A caretaker's request links a grounds crew, rinsed equipment, and a temporary room restriction.
t0027-02.rival_reading: A response crew could have rinsed equipment and restricted access after an emergency; the note never identifies what treatment reached the grounds.
